candidate_scoring: Restricted softmax over eight fixed single-token leading-space color logits at the final query position. No gold tokens/length enter model inputs.

data_manifest.family_rule: Reserve original world and its four one-key next-color edits; reject overlap with every previously chosen family, including across partitions.
data_manifest.training: Use original member only, all four object queries per training family.
data_manifest.validation: Select each trained arm checkpoint by mean restricted-eight-choice CE over original and targeted-counterfactual members.
data_manifest.test_views: IID, source-only, query-only, joint. Same world families and answers across views; these are paired presentations, not independent datasets.
data_manifest.counterfactual: Only the queried object's color advances one step in the fixed color cycle; the query and all other facts stay fixed.
data_manifest.nuisance: Only the next unqueried object's color advances one step; queried answer stays fixed.
data_manifest.oracle: Parse the complete symbolic facts and select query_key; task-solvability check only, not an LM baseline or performance claim.

validation_competence_gate.metric: Task-adapted full-text validation original/counterfactual record accuracy, required separately for every seed

structured_parser_oracle.role: Deterministic task-solvability check with complete structured facts; not an LM or a communication efficiency result.

uncertainty.cluster_unit: Original world family including all four queries, edits, and renderings
uncertainty.method: Average each family's score over its four queries and three fixed seeds; resample whole families with identical draw indices for every arm/view/contrast.
uncertainty.scope: Descriptive 95% intervals conditional on these fixed seeds. Three seeds do not support a population-of-training-seeds confidence claim. No multiplicity-adjusted significance claim.

sender_observation.actual_sender_execution: Cached once per unique source text across all splits/views/conditions

limits: This is a small synthetic lookup task, not real-world agent work, universal communication, or a new method claim.
Constant, zero, and frozen-no-channel inputs do not change within a targeted pair, so paired both-correct is structurally zero; beating this alone is weak evidence.
Different-family source shuffling is coherent across members and uses no labels; coincidentally matching colors remain possible.
Adaptation architecture/initialization/order/update budgets are equal; input lengths and therefore FLOPs are not equal.
Template views reuse the same world families; uncertainty resamples families jointly and is conditional on only three fixed training seeds.
All settings are fixed before held-out scoring. The validation gate describes interpretability, not a hyperparameter tuning loop.
Closed-choice classification eliminates generation-format errors but does not measure open-ended generation or inference speed.
The structured-parser oracle proves solvability with complete facts only; it is not evidence for an LM or a latent bandwidth advantage.
